scenarios.title: Product search
scenarios.assertion: A seeded product is returned by the intended search.

scenarios.title: Filtering
scenarios.assertion: The selected product filters produce the expected fixture subset.

scenarios.title: Product detail
scenarios.assertion: The detail matches the selected catalog product.

scenarios.title: Reseller journey
scenarios.assertion: The chosen supported reseller workflow produces its specified result.

scenarios.title: Permission boundary
scenarios.assertion: A separately configured restricted test user cannot perform the protected action chosen for the exercise.
